title: Turkish Airlines: Stockholm SYD $1220/MEL $1257, Warsaw SYD $1250/MEL $1252, Zurich SYD $1279/MEL $1298 Return @ Google Flights
body:
Deal: Turkish Airlines: Stockholm SYD $1220/MEL $1257, Warsaw SYD $1250/MEL $1252, Zurich SYD $1279/MEL $1298 Return @ Google Flights

[Wiadro] 2 stops is hard with a baby.
But maybe it’s easier
[bluepop] Do you need to pay for a visa to stay in your free hotel room?
[ezza] Its on the page under Terms & Conditions:
Visa, Transportation, and Additional Costs
Obtaining all travel documents required for entry into and exit from Türkiye, as well as any visa fees, duties, and similar expenses, is the responsibility of the passenger. Passengers are advised to check the applicable entry requirements before travel and visit the e-Visa page.
The Stopover Accommodation Service covers hotel accommodation and breakfast only. Any additional expenses are the responsibility of the passenger.
Transportation and transfer services are not provided within the scope of the Stopover Accommodation Service. Transportation expenses between the airport and hotel, as well as local transportation and travel expenses, are the responsibility of the passenger.
[bluepop] It is $60USD to get a visa for Australians making a stopover not worth it.
[ezza] Depends.. is $60USD a good fee to pay to see Istanbul for some hours wondering around with a free hotel stay… I think so!
Obviously you'd need to add your taxi/public transport cost in/out back from city.
[BargHunter100] I thought Türkiye was visa free for Australians from this year?
[ezza] @BargHunter100: Yes you are bang on.. i just googled it.. looks like it changed from April 17 2026!
[jaybo] probably worth the asterisk that this is not a blanket "no visa required" but if you hold an ordinary Australian passport which would be the assumption for a lot of people on this site, yep, no visa required
there's a fairly decent summary/list here too for those of you who arent't on a regular AU passport - https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Visa_policy_of_Turkey
[derrko] I for 1 would never use gotogate and associates to book flights. Read the reviews.
